annotation.title_clean: ICAO Model UAS Regulations (Parts 101, 102 and 149) with Advisory Circulars AC 101-1, AC 102-1, AC 102-37
annotation.title_en: ICAO Model UAS Regulations (Parts 101, 102 and 149) with Advisory Circulars AC 101-1, AC 102-1, AC 102-37
annotation.summary_en: ICAO's model regulations for unmanned aircraft systems, offering States template rules: Part 101 (Open Category), Part 102 (Specific Category) and Part 149 (Approved Aviation Organizations), with advisory circulars on guidance, operator certificates and dangerous goods carriage. A living document intended to help States regulate drones.
key_provisions_or_claims: Part 101 Open Category: all unmanned aircraft registered; up to 25 kg under standard conditions need no further operational review; over 15 kg require inspection/approval
Part 102 Specific Category covers aircraft over 25 kg or operations outside Part 101, via certification and authorizations
Part 149 enables Approved Aviation Organizations as designees for remote pilot licensing and aircraft inspection
AC 102-37 addresses carriage of dangerous goods by unmanned aircraft
Living document; ICAO invites States to share UAS regulations and may assist implementation
